String methods and immutability

Strings are immutable sequences of UTF-16 code units. Methods like trim, slice, split, includes
and replace return values without changing the original string.

Interview question: Why does a string method not update the original variable?
Answer: Strings are immutable; assign the returned value if you want a new binding value.
Remember: String methods return new values.
